item.description:
Search public MCP registries

The Add MCP sheet gains a Registries source: search the official MCP registry, Smithery, and the Docker MCP Catalog, then stage a result as a regular custom MCP through the usual Queue → Apply flow.

New

  • Add subagents from a registry — Subagents now have a full Add flow: browse a remote registry of ready-made agents by division, preview a definition, and roll it out with staged Apply instead of authoring files by hand.
  • Share your setup as a link — Publish a read-only showcase of your Global configuration as a static web page and hand teammates a link.
  • Agents can install Store MCPs via Hub — FullHouse Hub gains a write mode: agents plan and apply Yandex MCP Store installs as one guarded transaction, with the same preview and rollback rules as the app.

Improved

  • Fewer refreshes, steadier agents — The MCP Store catalog is discovered once per session and reused for 15 minutes, and Codex account capabilities re-export periodically, so long-running sessions no longer fail readiness checks.
